# Data Source: tfe_organization_run_task

Gets information on an [Organization Run task](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cloud-docs/workspaces/settings/run-tasks#creating-a-run-task).

[Run tasks](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cloud-docs/workspaces/settings/run-tasks) allow HCP Terraform to interact with external systems at specific points in the HCP Terraform run lifecycle. Run tasks are reusable configurations that you can attach to any workspace in an organization.

## Example Usage

```csharp
using Constructs;
using HashiCorp.Cdktf;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
using Gen.Providers.Tfe;
class MyConvertedCode : TerraformStack
{
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, string name) : base(scope, name)
    {
        new DataTfeOrganizationRunTask.DataTfeOrganizationRunTask(this, "example", new DataTfeOrganizationRunTaskConfig {
            Name = "task-name",
            Organization = "my-org-name"
        });
    }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `Name` (String) Name of the Run task.

### Optional

- `Category` (String) The type of task.
- `Description` (String) A short description of the task.
- `Enabled` (Boolean) Whether the task will be run.
- `Organization` (String) Name of the organization.
- `Url` (String) URL to send a task payload.

### Read-Only

- `Id` (String) The ID for the Run task.
